description: A piezoelectric buzzer that produces sound when driven with a signal.
how_to_use: Pin 1 (negative, black) connects to ground; pin 2 (positive, red) connects to the signal/power pin — these are labeled by polarity, not treated as an interchangeable pair.

pins.2: positive (+) — to the Arduino pin that drives it

plain.what: A little speaker that beeps or plays simple tunes.
plain.how: The + leg (longer, marked +) to an Arduino pin, the other leg to GND. Your program makes it beep with the tone() command.
